text:
maria: heads-up — post-deploy synthetic for /embed-route spiking. p95 latency variance x3 on canary (5% traffic). seeing errors go from ~0.2% to 1.1%. deciding whether to hold.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: canary rollout v2.3.8 -> v2.3.9 at 1743219900, traffic 5%. smoke probes started 1743219950. recent probe failures: 12/50.

kevin: looks like adaptive-smoke-threshold flag was enabled in the release config (auto-tune: true). that lowered tolerance for tail latency noise. could be noise amplification.

liz: :eyes: did we change any model variant or quant profiles in this release? if not, flag flip is plausible root cause.

maria: no model change — only small routing tweak + the adaptive flag. i'd prefer flipping the flag off and running extra smoke before deciding rollback.

sre-oncall: recommend holding rollout until we confirm. plan A: disable adaptive-smoke-threshold and re-run synth for 10m. Plan B: if probes still fail, pin traffic back to v2.3.8 (previous stable) for canary.

kevin: i can flip the flag. to be safe i'll do it via the config service patch: 
```
PATCH /api/v1/configs/deployments/edge-canary
{
  "adaptive_smoke": false
}
```
will route change take effect within ~30s.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline: commit sha 3f2b9cd (release/v2.3.9) — no other infra changes. quick patch available: config-only rollback toggle (hotfix) can be applied without redeploy.

maria: ok kevin — do it, then start a focused synth run on canary for 10m and post results. i'll hold the window (do not progress to ramp) and notify product + docs about potential release note update.

liz: i'll draft a brief note for the changelog: "tuned rollout: adaptive smoke temporarily disabled due to probe sensitivity; monitoring ongoing." will flag for release-notes channel after final.

kevin: flipped flag at 1743219998. monitoring now.

deploy-bot: synth run: restarting probes 1743220010 -> collecting 60 samples/min.

sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 + TLS errors. if failures drop below 0.5% and latency variance normalizes in 10m, we can continue ramp. else we pin to v2.3.8 and schedule rollback window.

maria: thanks everyone. i'll call the hold for now. if by 1743220612 (10m) green, we resume. otherwise pinned rollback decision.

kevin: noted. will post metrics in 5m. :thumbsup:

liz: tagging @product for visibility and to prep a one-line alert for customers if rollback occurs.

maria: perfect. leaving notes here so ops history is clear.
